# Task: Build Pure-MLOps Project (Projet MLOps Complet — MLOps skills maximization)

You are working in a git worktree for the repo "mlops-full-mlops-skills-project". Read the authoritative spec file in this directory: `mlops-full-mlops-skills-project.md` (in French) and implement it EXACTLY. This project is 100% MLOps tooling: NO Kubernetes, NO Terraform/Ansible, NO Vault, NO infra monitoring. Code comments/README in English (README can be bilingual).

Use case: Customer churn (or credit scoring) binary classification WITH a sensitive attribute (e.g. gender or age) for the fairness checks. Generate a realistic synthetic churn CSV (~7000 rows) via a python script you write and run; commit the script and the data under `data/raw/`.

On each iteration: inspect current repo state first, continue from where you left off, and do not stop until everything below is built, validated, and committed on branch agent/backend-agent (git add -A && git commit -m "..." after progress).

## Repo layout (per spec §4 tree)
- `data/{raw,processed,reference}`; `great_expectations/expectations/dataset_suite.json` (expectations: no nulls on critical columns, numeric value ranges e.g. age 18-100, dtypes, minimum row count).
- `feature_repo/`: feature_store.yaml, entities.py, features.py (FeatureView with TTL, schema e.g. Float32/Int64 fields), data_sources.py (Parquet source; point-in-time correctness so offline/online features match).
- `pipelines/`: training_pipeline.py, tuning_pipeline.py, retraining_pipeline.py (ZenML @step/@pipeline, step caching, MLflow ExperimentTracker integration).
- `src/data/{ingestion.py (logs row count, time period, source file hash), preprocessing.py (pure functions)}`.
- `src/features/build_features.py`.
- `src/models/`: train.py (mlflow.start_run, log params + metrics accuracy/f1/roc_auc + artifacts), tune.py (Optuna bayesian search ~50 trials, each trial a nested mlflow run), automl_baseline.py (FLAML or AutoGluon comparative baseline), evaluate.py, explain.py (SHAP TreeExplainer summary plot saved to reports/, plus LIME for local explanations), fairness_check.py (Fairlearn: MetricFrame, demographic_parity_difference, equalized_odds_difference, selection rate; reject if dp_diff > 0.1), export_onnx.py (skl2onnx conversion + parity check within tolerance vs original model), promote.py (promotion gates: F1 above threshold, beats current Production model, Deepchecks passed, fairness passed).
- `src/serving/`: bento_service.py (BentoML Service with predict AND explain endpoints), champion_challenger.py (route ~10% traffic to challenger, log every routing decision).
- `src/monitoring/`: drift_report.py (Evidently Report with DataDriftPreset + TargetDriftPreset, save HTML to monitoring/reports/drift_report.html, extract dataset_drift score), retraining_trigger.py (triggers retraining when drift_score above threshold).
- `model_cards/model_card_template.py` (auto-generate model card markdown from MLflow metrics + fairness results).
- `tests/{unit,model,data}` empty dirs only (QA agent fills). `notebooks/exploration.ipynb` (valid JSON). `mlflow/mlruns/`. `dvc.yaml` (stages: validate, preprocess, build_features — per spec §7.2). `requirements.txt` (scikit-learn, pandas, mlflow, optuna, flaml, feast, zenml, shap, lime, fairlearn, skl2onnx, onnxruntime, evidently, great-expectations, bentoml, deepchecks; pin sensible versions), `pyproject.toml`, `Dockerfile.bento`, `README.md`.

## Validation
- `python3 -m py_compile` on every .py file.
- If deps installable (`pip install scikit-learn pandas mlflow optuna shap --quiet`), run the core path end-to-end: generate data -> preprocess -> train -> tune (small trial count) -> register model -> generate SHAP and fairness reports. Fix errors until it works. If full deps unavailable, ensure the core path is correct and the rest is well-structured.

## Completion
When the ENTIRE repository above is built, validated, and committed on branch agent/backend-agent, output exactly:
<promise>BUILD_COMPLETE</promise>
Do not output that tag before everything is genuinely done.
